subject: EURORA AP: VAT split invoicing / PO references needed for vendor activation
messages:
From: Accounts Payable <ap@eurora.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 15:15:00 +02:00
Subject: Vendor activation: Redwood — VAT splitting + PO requirements

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for taking this — we're ready to onboard Redwood as a vendor but have a few mandatory AP requirements before we can activate your account in our system. Please confirm you can provide the following and attach the required files to your activation email: 

- Legal entity that will issue invoices to Eurora (we require billing from an EU-registered entity for VAT purposes where applicable).
- Supplier Tax ID / VAT registration number (for cross-border supplies).
- Invoices must be split by VAT jurisdiction when a single invoice covers services billed to multiple Eurora subsidiaries (example: line items with different VAT rates must include VAT rate and VAT registration ID for the billed subsidiary).
- PO reference: every invoice must include the customer PO in the invoice header and in the invoice metadata (field name: "Customer PO").
- Required header fields: Invoice Date, Invoice Number, SupplierID, CustomerID, PO Number, Line-level VAT rate and VAT ID.
- Bank details: IBAN + BIC/Swift; we prefer SEPA where available.
- Tax form: W-9 (or W-8-BEN if non-US) and an EU VAT certificate if the supplier is registered in the EU.
- Preferred invoice delivery: ap@eurora.com (email) and SFTP (contact for SFTP details below if you support).

Can you send a sample invoice (PDF) and your tax docs? We usually enable vendor payment terms after we receive a test invoice and a completed vendor profile—target activation date is 2028-06-28 to hit our billing cycle. If you have EDI/CSV mappings, please include them.

Best,
Martin Koenig
Head of Accounts Payable
Eurora GmbH
ap@eurora.com

---
Please note: Eurora standard payment terms are Net 60 unless otherwise agreed.

Hi Naomi / Laura,

We can support line-level VAT rates and include the VAT registration ID at the line item level. A couple of technical notes / options: 

- Invoice header fields: we will populate SupplierID (our internal vendor code), Supplier VAT ID, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, CustomerID (Eurora master account), and Customer PO in both header and metadata.
- For multi-entity billing (EU entity vs Redwood Inc), we need Eurora to confirm which legal entity will accept the invoice per PO. If the PO is for an EU subsidiary, we should bill from Redwood EU (to avoid reverse-charge issues).
- Delivery formats: PDF by email is fine for activation. For automated ingestion we can produce a CSV/EDI file with a mapping file (sample attached in this thread). Suggested CSV columns: invoice_num, invoice_date, supplier_id, supplier_vat, customer_id, customer_po, line_desc, qty, unit_price, tax_rate, tax_id.
- I will generate a TEST invoice with PO reference D-98431-TEST once Naomi confirms which billing entity to use.
